        "9": "Cut-Cut 1/4 medium carrot into short, thin strips",
        "10": "Mix-Mix 1/4 cup sweet-and-sour sauce and 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce in a small bowl",
        "11": "Top-Top the plate with the carrots, onion, garlic and 1/4 tsp pepper powder",
        "12": "Microwave-Microwave for 1 more minute",
        "13": "Mince-Mince 1/8 garlic clove",
